name: tracediff
description: Structural diffing of execution traces with Merkle-indexed divergence localization

scripts.build: bun build src/lambda/submit-job.ts src/lambda/get-job.ts src/lambda/diff-worker.ts src/lambda/presign.ts src/lambda/load-traces.ts src/lambda/aggregate.ts src/lambda/update-status.ts --target=node --outdir=dist/lambda && bun -e "require('node:fs').writeFileSync('dist/lambda/package.json', '{\"name\":\"tracediff-lambda\",\"version\":\"1.0.0\",\"type\":\"module\"}')"
scripts.deploy:frontend: aws s3 sync frontend/ s3://tracediff-web-140023404870-dev/ --delete && aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E1574K2273MQ8K --paths "/*"

author: Maaz Ahmad, Lavanya Varshney, Divyansh Gupta
